evaluator_only.boundary_definition: realized centre displacement with tolerance 1e-12; stall is <=1e-12

freeze.environment: unchanged D026Env / D024 finite-body dual-contact physics

learner.reset: 168 weights zero at deliberate new-lifetime start only
learner.update: weights += 0.5 * (observed_delta - dot(weights, x)) * x / dot(x, x)

lifetime: one uninterrupted causal lifetime per seed

shadow_isolation.reference: identical D-026 controller/environment replay without learner
